body_lead: BENGALURU: The Krishi Mela at the University of Agricultural Sciences (UAS) offers a glimpse into science, technology and the future of farming. From AI-powered robots and micro air vehicles (MAVs) inspired by insect flight to precision dairy platforms and agri-tourism models, innovation took centre stage at the GKVK campus. One of the main attractions was the ‘Keeta Vismaya’ (Insect Exhibition) — the display introduced visitors to the fascinating world of insects. It featured live species, insect models, and information on their life cycles, habitats, and ecological importance.
